product_one_liner.value: Levitate is an AI-powered relationship intelligence platform for businesses that grow through repeat clients and referrals, helping them manage and strengthen customer relationships.

pricing_page.notes: The plans page is public, although pricing directs visitors to contact sales.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a marketing/product-content blog rather than an engineering or technical blog.

public_docs.notes: Levitate has a public help center with multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists five openings; the listed titles are sales, account executive, and revenue-operations roles, not AI/ML/data-science roles.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude and Google LLC models
model_provider.notes: Levitate says it builds with Claude; its underlying-model-provider page names Google LLC.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly names SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS (SAQ A); no claim of ISO 27001 or GDPR is included.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook records $15.9M; the company’s announcement rounded the amount to $16M.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding announcement is dated 2026-03-05, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Sales Development Representative openings and an Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Levitate announced new AI tools on 2026-09-25, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Casey Brady’s profile shows a Levitate start date of 2026-04-01; the company team page identifies Brady as a senior vice president.
